description: Bonds, notes, or debentures issuance with principal, rate, maturity, covenants, and use of proceeds.

Material executive or director compensation changes including new employment agreements, amendments, severance, change-in-control provisions, or equity awards. Consolidates all compensation-related events into a single tag.
Annual meeting results including elections, ratifications, and proposal outcomes.
Investor presentations, conference materials, or earnings call supplements disclosed for broad dissemination.
Underwriting or placement agent agreement for securities distribution in offerings.
Other named executive officer departure with circumstances.
Quarterly financial results including revenue, net income, EPS, and key operating metrics with management commentary.
Shareholder proposal outcomes with support levels and management response.
Other named executive officer appointment with position and terms.
Director resignation, removal, retirement, or decision not to stand for re-election, including any disagreements causing departure.
New director election or appointment with background, qualifications, and committee assignments.
Cash dividend, special dividend, or distribution declaration with amount, record date, and payment date.
Credit agreement, loan facility, or revolving credit arrangement. Includes amendments modifying capacity, rates, covenants, or maturity.

Issuance, revision, or reaffirmation of financial guidance including revenue projections, earnings estimates, and key metric forecasts. Consolidates all guidance-related disclosures regardless of disclosure mechanism.
Business performance, market conditions, or operational updates communicated to investors.
Bylaw amendment with nature of changes and impact on governance or shareholder rights.
Issuance or release of guarantees, letters of credit, or keepwell agreements.
Purchase, redemption, tender, or early retirement of outstanding debt securities.

Certificate or articles of incorporation amendment, including changes to shareholder voting, dividend, or liquidation rights. Use this for the governance action; use preferred_stock_modification for preferred-specific term changes.
Share buyback program authorization, expansion, or update with amount and timing.
Strategic plans, business transformation, or market entry/exit that represent material changes to business direction.
New CFO appointment with background, terms, and transition timeline.
Unregistered securities under equity compensation plans for employees, directors, or consultants.
CEO departure, resignation, retirement, termination, or death with circumstances and transition.
CFO departure with circumstances and transition arrangements.
Material nonrecurring charges, gains, or unusual items significantly affecting results (e.g., restructuring charges, legal settlements, one-time gains).
Definitive agreement to acquire a business, subsidiary, or division, specifying price, financing, and conditions.
Definitive merger or business combination agreement with exchange ratios and terms.
Preliminary or unaudited financial results before formal statement preparation.
Termination, expiration, or non-renewal of a material agreement due to term completion, mutual agreement, or exercise of termination rights.
Settlement resolving material litigation, regulatory proceedings, or disputes. Use this instead of material_litigation when the event is the settlement itself.
Completed business acquisition with final purchase price, financing, and integration plans.
Material modification of preferred stock terms including conversion, dividend, redemption, or voting provisions.
Public equity offering or registered direct offering with underwriting terms.
New CEO appointment with background, employment terms, and compensation.
Unregistered securities issued as merger or acquisition consideration.
Restructuring or cost reduction initiative with expected charges, timeline, and anticipated savings.
Tender offer to acquire outstanding securities (equity, debt, or trust preferred) with pricing and conditions.
Long-lived or intangible asset impairment or write-down with asset nature and circumstances.
SEC, DOJ, or other regulatory investigation, Wells notice, or enforcement action.
Forward or reverse stock split with ratio, dates, and share impact.
Annual financial results with year-over-year comparisons, key metrics, and forward outlook.
Definitive agreement to sell a business unit, subsidiary, or product line.
Decision to exit or discontinue a business line, product category, or market segment.
Significant litigation updates, outcomes, or judgments not covered by settlement_agreement.
Significant layoffs, RIFs, or voluntary separation programs with positions, severance, and timeline.
Completed spinoff, split-off, or separation creating independent entity with distribution details.
Rule 10b5-1 trading plan adoption, modification, or termination by officers, directors, or affiliates.
Completed merger or business combination with resulting ownership structure.
Capital allocation strategy, financial plan, or investment priorities communicated to investment community.
Material change to dividend policy including suspension, reduction, or significant increase.
Loss of controlling interest through sale, dilution, or other transaction.
Joint venture, partnership, or collaboration agreement defining shared activities and governance.
Regulatory approvals, rejections, complete response letters, or information requests from FDA, EPA, or other agencies.
Special meeting results on mergers, charter amendments, or other significant actions.
Material cybersecurity incident, data breach, ransomware, or information security event affecting systems or data.
Facility closures, consolidations, or relocations with locations, employees, and charges.
Blackout period notice during which benefit plan trading will be suspended.
Private placement of unregistered equity to accredited investors or QIBs, with terms and registration rights.
Completed sale or divestiture with proceeds, gain/loss, and strategic rationale.
Material contract win or commercial agreement outside ordinary course affecting future revenues.
Transfer between exchanges or market tiers, or initial listing approval.
New auditor engagement with prior consultations and change disclosures.
Goodwill impairment charge when carrying value exceeds fair value, with amount and affected reporting unit.
Borrowing under existing credit facilities or term loans with amount and purpose.
Partnership, collaboration, or commercial relationship agreement affecting operations or competitive position.
Significant new product, service offering, or technology development affecting future performance.
Voluntary bankruptcy filing (Chapter 7, 11, 15) with circumstances and expected impact.
Acquisition of controlling interest by new shareholder, investor group, or entity.
Activist engagement including demands, proxy contests, settlements, or board nominations.
Other-than-temporary impairment on investments or securities with amount and nature.
Material supply, distribution, or purchasing commitment establishing long-term obligations.
Unregistered securities from warrant/option exercise or convertible security conversion.
Licensing or technology transfer agreement for patents, trademarks, or proprietary technology.
Completed purchase or sale of significant individual assets (real estate, equipment, IP) outside ordinary course.
Clinical trial data for pharma, biotech, or medical devices including efficacy and safety findings.
Material accounting error correction not requiring full restatement but requiring disclosure.
Mine safety violations, citations, or penalties from MSHA requiring corrective action or fines.
Prior financial statements should not be relied upon due to material errors requiring restatement.
Voluntary decision to delist with rationale and alternative trading arrangements.
Withdrawal from or cancellation of a pending agreement before completion, with rationale and any fees.
Fiscal year end change with old and new dates, transition period, and rationale.
Material weakness in internal control over financial reporting requiring disclosure and remediation.
Annual or special meeting announcement with dates, agenda, and record date.
Regained listing compliance after previous deficiency notice.
Exchange determination to delist securities with effective date and reasons.
Rights offering to existing shareholders to purchase additional shares at a discount.
Material changes to ABS structure including servicer/trustee replacement, credit enhancement modification, or trust document amendments.
Failure to make required ABS distribution with missed amount, reasons, and expected remediation.
Actual failure to make required principal or interest payment on outstanding debt.
Net asset value per share for BDCs, closed-end funds, interval funds, or non-traded REITs.
Disagreements with auditors on accounting principles, disclosures, or audit scope.
Adoption, amendment, or termination of a shareholder rights plan (poison pill) or similar anti-takeover mechanism.
Shareholder director nominations under proxy access or advance notice bylaws.
Code of ethics amendment or waiver for principal executive, financial, or accounting officers.
Reverse merger where private operating company merges with public shell, becoming publicly traded. Includes shell company status changes.
Going-private, management buyout, or similar transaction ending public trading.
Credit rating downgrade triggering contractual consequences (increased rates, collateral, acceleration).
Notice of failure to satisfy continued listing requirements with cure period.
Mining operations closure due to safety concerns or violation patterns with production impact.
Breach or anticipated breach of financial covenants, with waivers obtained or amendments to cure.
Off-balance sheet obligations including VIEs, synthetic leases, or structured finance with real exposure.
Patent grants, issuances, or significant IP milestones from USPTO or international offices.
Withdrawal of auditor opinion on prior statements requiring reissuance.
Material ESG initiative, sustainability target, or environmental/social development the company considers significant.
Credit rating upgrade, downgrade, outlook modification, or watch placement by rating agencies.
Significant lease for real property, equipment, or facilities including operating, finance, and sale-leaseback.
Termination of a material agreement due to breach or default, with associated penalties or disputes.
Class action lawsuit filed against the company with claims and potential exposure.
Events triggering debt acceleration, interest rate increases, or debt term modifications.
Independent auditor dismissal with reasons and reportable events.
Involuntary bankruptcy petition by creditors with petitioner identity and amounts.
Appointment of receiver, trustee, or conservator to control assets with scope and duration.
Confirmation of reorganization plan or emergence from bankruptcy with creditor treatment and new capital structure.
Going concern doubt expressed by auditors or management, substantial doubt about ability to continue operations.
Withdrawal or suspension of previously issued financial guidance.
Natural disaster, catastrophic event, or force majeure impact on operations, facilities, or financial condition.
Independent auditor resignation with date and any disagreements.
PIPE transaction involving unregistered securities at market discount with registration rights.
